metrics.legacy: one-sided observed point to nearest MHR vertex; retained only for V1 comparison
metrics.point_to_triangle: exact one-sided observed point to continuous MHR triangle surface
metrics.rendered_depth: absolute observed-vs-rendered Camera-B Z residual on overlap pixels, always reported with mesh coverage

primary_development_metric: held-out Camera-B point-to-triangle median, aggregated by subject
limitations: one-sided geometry does not penalize unseen mesh regions
DEV choices must be frozen before sealed-test access
